THEORETICAL CONDENSED MATTER PHYSICS

Hyeongmuk Lim (Mook)

I study the topology and quantum geometry of electronic bands. A question guiding my work is how the wave-function structure of noninteracting electrons can shape correlated quantum matter.

SELECTED RESEARCH

Selected publications

All publications →

Two representative directions in my work: extending ideal quantum geometry to time-reversal-symmetric systems, and uncovering delicate band topology.

2026

Quaternion-Kähler geometry of time reversal symmetric crystals

Hyeongmuk Lim, Junseo Jung, Yuting Qian, Bohm-Jung Yang

arXiv preprint

Identifies quaternion-Kähler quantum geometry for Kramers pairs, extending ideal-band geometric relations to time-reversal-symmetric multiband states. This provides a possible starting point for exploring correlated phases without breaking time reversal.

arXiv ↗
2023

Real Hopf insulator

Hyeongmuk Lim, Sunje Kim, Bohm-Jung Yang

Physical Review B · 108, 125101

Establishes the real Hopf insulator in four-band PT-symmetric systems, whose delicate topology depends on both occupied and unoccupied bands.
